_comment: Firmware files GRID can check and install without RomM (romm-storefront-plan 0.9), generated by scripts/data/gen_firmware_known_json.py; do not edit by hand. Hashes from libretro-database dat/System.dat at commit 2a8de0276fd7d3095f2501c3de3799a14c37e910, (c) libretro, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). ShareAlike: this file is an adaptation of System.dat and is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. Entries keyed <slug>:<name> as RomM 5.4.1 keys backend/models/fixtures/known_bios_files.json (RomM, https://github.com/rommapp/romm, AGPL-3.0); entries with source romm come from that file. Entries with an empty md5 are per-console files with no fixed checksum: they install as not verified. required/group/match are GRID's own policy.
